arguments.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: One finished static PC in-game screen for the coastal narrative game 来自月亮的 Z. Landscape 16:9. This is the cafe work-and-shop interaction screen, not a website or a presentation.

Input images and roles:
Image 1 (06-private-dialogue.png) is the primary style reference. Match its lateral 2.5D coastal hand-painted environment, small adult characters, indigo shadows, amber practical lights, coral interaction focus, subtle ivory typography, and restrained translucent charcoal UI. Keep the same player identity.
Image 2 (island-map-v2.png) is only a secondary reference for simplified painted material, coherent color blocks and palette. Do NOT use its aerial/top-down perspective or map composition.

Scene and composition:
Eye-level lateral cutaway-like view of a seaside cafe interior. The illustrated room occupies approximately the left 65–68 percent of the canvas; a calm translucent charcoal panel occupies the right approximately 30–32 percent. The room is the visual home of the interaction. Show a wooden counter, a few clear cups and saucers, warm pendant lamps, and a broad window overlooking a cool blue-violet bay. Dark foreground frame, midground counter and people, distant sea create clear horizontal 2.5D layers. Designed broad shapes and painterly color masses with restrained texture, minimal sparkling fragments. No photorealism, glossy 3D, isometric dollhouse, perspective shopping mall, or cute chibi style.
Show exactly two small adult characters. The player is a brown-haired adult wearing a rust-orange jacket, a visible stagehand lanyard/badge, dark trousers, and dark shoes, standing at the counter. The adult female cafe proprietor is visibly different from Z, with tied-up hair and a muted apron, behind the counter. Their full-body scale should be small, about 18–22 percent of canvas height. Z is absent. Do not add patrons or dialogue bubbles.

Palette and UI:
Deep indigo and gray-violet room shadows, amber lamps, muted blue sea, warm ivory text. Coral is reserved for the selected flashlight and primary purchase button. Right panel uses fine restrained lines, generous spacing, translucent charcoal background, consistent crisp Chinese sans-serif text, no heavy rounded cards or dashboard widgets. Keep key Chinese text large enough to read at this full-screen scale; body text around the visual equivalent of 26–30 pixels at 1920px width. One visual system with the reference, not ecommerce cards or a SaaS dashboard.

Exact visible text and layout:
Top left over a quiet dark area:
"海边咖啡馆"
"第 5 日 · 准备时段"

At the upper right inside the panel show the current balance, clearly:
"零钱 48"

Upper panel section, visually quieter than the shop, with this exact text:
"临时帮工"
"完成一班 +30"
"耗时 1 个时段"
"结束后进入休息时段"
A thin ivory-outline, secondary button: "开始帮工"

Separate the two functional sections with a subtle fine line and generous space.
Lower panel section heading:
"柜台小物"

Under it show three simple compact horizontal list rows, not product cards, with minimal small silhouettes and the prices right-aligned:
"手电筒"  "18"
"胶带"  "12"
"电池"  "8"

The flashlight row is selected with a coral focus line/accent and coral text; the two other rows remain ivory and lower emphasis.
Below the rows show the selected item's brief description:
"照亮昏暗角落"
Then a clear coral-accented primary button:
"购买 · 18"

At the lower left, the only keyboard hint:
"Esc 返回"

Rules:
This is before the purchase, so the balance remains 48. Do not show 30 as a remaining balance, no success toast, and no duplicated purchase button. The +30 is only the pay for completing one work shift, clearly separated from the item prices. The work action must show its time cost and next period. All Chinese copy must be exactly as specified, crisp, accurate and legible. Do not invent item descriptions, inventory counts, navigation tabs, relationship values, quest trackers, omniscient safety indicators, sales labels, coins raining, HUD meters, extra text, or external branding. Do not add Z. Preserve a quiet narrative-game feel and coherent proportions.

visual_self_check: Main Chinese UI labels, 48 balance, +30 work income, time cost, next period, 18/12/8 item prices and pre-purchase state checked. No blocking text or logic issue found. Static image only; income, prices and items are illustrative.
